overview: The Armory Bastion is the industrial heart of Sanctus Seru’s military power, producing weapons, armor, and arcane‑reinforced equipment.
history: Built during the early rise of Seru’s authoritarian regime.
Arcane forges were added to improve weapon resonance and durability.
The bastion expanded to support Praetorian and Legion deployments.
Command vaults were constructed to store edict‑bound armaments.
hooks: A forge overheats, threatening a chain reaction.
A shipment of Praetorian plate goes missing.
Arcane weapon cores destabilize across the bastion.
A sealed edict orders emergency production of ceremonial gear.
